title: LotKeys Info
summary: V0.9.4.78 keeps the approved V0.9.4.77 Vehicle Profile workflow, simplifies More Media availability, and bundles Posting Buddy V0.1.18 selective Facebook updates with faster optional video handling.

blocks.text: Vehicle Profiles keep the approved V0.9.4.77 Pending layout. Open Your More Media Folder now sits directly in the action area with no extra bubble and stays grey until the signed-in user actually has More Media content for that vehicle. Posting Buddy V0.1.18 moves Video, Photos, Description and Details into one horizontal speed row, turns posted Listings into selective Update jobs, discovers official and signed-in-user More Media video candidates from Drive duration metadata, prepares a chosen video while other Facebook content is filling, and returns directly to Listings after the live Facebook URL is saved. Store Processor V0.9.4.76 remains current.
